data.one_liner: Custom side menu drawer implementation with sliding, rotation, and shadow effects
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom side menu (drawer) widget that supports various animation styles including sliding, rotation, and shadows. It includes a controller for programmatic opening and closing, and supports both LTR and RTL layouts.
use_when: You want a customized side menu or drawer with rotation and shadow animations.
Your app needs to support both Left-to-Right and Right-to-Left layouts seamlessly.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material Design Drawer widget built into Flutter.
You require complex navigation structures that are better handled by nested navigation packages.
strengths: Supports multiple styling options like 3D/rotation effects and shadows.
Includes LTR and RTL support out of the box.
Provides both a controller and static methods to manage drawer state.
weaknesses: Custom animations might not fit standard Material guidelines depending on usage.
data.minimal_example:
AwesomeDrawerBar(
  controller: AwesomeDrawerBarController(),
  menuScreen: MENU_SCREEN,
  mainScreen: MAIN_SCREEN,
  borderRadius: 24.0,
  showShadow: true,
  angle: -12.0,
)
